helpIntro: Syracuse University uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter GPA-bearing Syracuse credits and grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate work outside the College of Law. Transfer grades do not enter the Syracuse GPA. Incompletes can affect GPA as failing work until resolved. Repeat/flagging rules vary by school or college, so Repeat Impact is not offered.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.999; together, 21.999 ÷ 6 = 3.667.

gradeExplanations.F: F earns 0 grade points and its credits remain GPA-bearing.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete currently calculates as failing work for GPA purposes until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass earns credit but is excluded from grade-point calculations.
gradeExplanations.NA: Non-attendance notation is not assigned grade points in this calculator; review the official record if applicable.
gradeExplanations.NR: Not Required is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.RM: Remedial notation is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.V: Variable-length course grade not yet due; excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.WD: Withdrawal is recorded without grade points and is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Syracuse University undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use the posted Syracuse grade and course credits.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer credits may apply to the degree, but outside grades do not calculate in the Syracuse University GPA.

specialTypes.name: College of Law course / law record
specialTypes.note: College of Law has separate GPA, repeat, graduation, and grading rules; use the Law record and official rules instead of this undergraduate calculator.

repeatPolicy.note: Check your home school/college flagging rule before estimating a repeated course.
